description: Expanded targeted literature audit; not a systematic review or claim of exhaustive coverage.
databases: Europe PMC (includes PubMed/MEDLINE and indexed preprints)
supplementaryDiscovery: Targeted web searches for named devices and validation terms
Backward citation checking from V3 framework, device reviews and included primary papers

discoveryReviews.role: Device survey and bibliography; manufacturer specifications not used as evidence
Myopia light-meter methods review and bibliography

screening: Three bounded queries were retrieved in full and deduplicated by source plus accession. A light/device title prefilter selected titles for inspection. Selected relevant records received primary-source checking. This was not independent dual screening, and the omitted records did not receive exhaustive abstract screening.
deduplication: Search counts use database source plus accession. Included papers are unique by DOI. Preprint/journal versions require curator checks, not just automatic DOI deduplication.
limitations: English search terms; no comprehensive non-English search.
No subscription Scopus, Web of Science or Embase search.
Database indexing delays, title prefilter and focused device vocabulary can miss studies.
Some entries rely on abstracts; exact hardware and reference models may remain unresolved.
Conference abstracts and theses identified but not comprehensively extracted.
Known candidates awaiting extraction are listed below; included-paper counts are not all retrieved hits.
pilotQueries: Three broad pilot files (named-devices.json, actigraphy-validation.json, wearable-validation.json) each contain only the first 1,000 results. They are not counted as complete searches or included in the final query accounting.
